 What is the volume of the cube shown in the diagram above?
question.worked_solution:
To find the volume $V$ of a cube, we cube its side length. Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}V & =(5\,\text{m})^{3} \\  & =5\,\text{m}\times 5\,\text{m}\times 5\,\text{m} \\  & =(5\times 5\times 5)\times (\text{m}\times \text{m}\times \text{m}) \\  & =125\,{\text{m}}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
